name: Lotus Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Lotus Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the production and sale of condiments and health food in China and internationally. The company offers soy sauce, oyster sauce, vinegar, cooking wine, braised sauce, and sesame oil; chicken essence, chicken powder, chicken juice, seasoning, dumpling materials, fried vegetables, spicy fresh and fresh mushroom, as well as octagonal, white pepper, black pepper, and cumin powder.
